official_definition: You can summon this card from the Hand/Removed Zone by using one 20px to pay for the entire summon cost, and putting cores from your Reserve onto it.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Soul Swift - Love] or [Soul Swift - Love: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Soul Swift - Love]", "give [Soul Swift - Love]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
